newsitem.title: CANADA: Vancouver air cargo traffic up 14.7 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Vancouver air cargo traffic up 14.7 pct in 1996.

text.p: Freight traffic at Vancouver International airport rose 14.7 percent to 199,197 tonnes last year, the airport authority said.
For the year, import freight at Canada's second busiest airport was up 22.2 percent to 92,310 tonnes while export freight rose nine percent to 106,887 tonnes.
December import freight rose 18.6 percent to 6,890 tonnes while export freight increased 2.2 percent to 8,445 tonnes.

Even with a 1.9 percent reduction in mail traffic, total 1996 cargo shipments at Vancouver still were 13.2 percent higher than the 1995 traffic level. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
